summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ZOZO Burger application after Phase 1 (Data Completion - 110 menu items) and Phase 2 (Frontend Stability). Tested all 4 premium features (Video Hero, Deals, Quick Reorder, Product Customizer) and complete order flow. Backend: 100% success (18/18 tests passed). Frontend: 95% success with minor deals display issue.

integration_issues.issue: Deals section not visible on homepage despite deals existing in backend
integration_issues.details: Backend API /api/admin/deals returns deals successfully (test deal created), but deals section is not rendering on homepage. Likely conditional rendering based on active deals or frontend fetch issue.
integration_issues.workaround: Deals can be managed via admin dashboard at /admin/deals
